source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly identifies the pre-OS manual boundary but does not bound south-bridge controllers, device dependencies or recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; supplies a useful controller/device map and recovery plan but treats automated supporting evidence as partial core execution.

original_test_intent: Verify that approved AMD South Bridge firmware controls persist across save/reboot and return to documented SPEC defaults after Load Default without disrupting the attached storage, USB, network, audio, low-speed I/O, boot or management paths governed by those controls.
original_method: Manually select bounded South Bridge controls, set approved non-default values, save/reboot and visually verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare the same controls with SPEC while checking dependent device and platform health.
manual_activity: A human must navigate the platform-specific South Bridge page, interpret each control, perform the approved edits and both reboot/default phases, and visually accept the firmware state. Automated inventories and logs are supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Exact South Bridge field-to-controller/device dependency map
Approved baseline, non-default and SPEC-default values
Critical boot, storage, USB, network and console paths
Console/operator, recovery media and BMC/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random; change only named fields with documented semantics and recovery.
Do not disable the active boot storage controller, console, management path or recovery media interface.
Capture dependent-device state before each mutation and stop on unexpected disappearance, remapping or degradation.
Stop on boot, storage, USB, network, console, reboot or management failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only firmware identity, PCI/USB/storage/network/audio, boot, OS-log and BMC evidence around operator phases.
Compare named controllers and devices against the approved dependency matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, change controllers, substitute OS configuration or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define and approve South Bridge fields, values, defaults, dependent devices and recovery.
Perform and capture non-default persistence and default-restoration phases.
Evaluate firmware and device-health evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent execution and preserves the manual BIOS workflow. There is no source command; generic OS device tools cannot prove the firmware values themselves.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the firmware procedure and add platform-approved read-only controller/device inventories only as corroborating evidence; do not replace the BIOS test with OS-level toggles.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/5-minute fields are preserved; all/random remains quoted source text but is not executable authorization.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Before execution, map each approved South Bridge field to its controller and critical devices; capture exact firmware values plus read-only dependent-device state across baseline, persistence, defaults and final restoration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The identified AMD board, BIOS/AGESA/chipset revision and installed peripheral topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, AGESA/chipset, OS and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BIOS field definitions, board documentation and AMD/vendor chipset guidance for the exact revision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces unbounded random selection with named controls and explicit controller/device correlation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; it preserves persistence/default coverage and adds proof that affected devices remain usable.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field semantics, controller/device topology, defaults and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: South Bridge labels and exposed controls vary by board and firmware revision; no field meaning may be inferred from the page title alone.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a safe subset of South Bridge controls and device checks. Completion applies only to that named matrix and cannot be reported as coverage of every control on the page.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, page inventory, field/controller/device map, approval and recovery
First save/reboot persistence plus dependent-device health
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and boot/peripheral/management health
Final configuration, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The persistence and default-restoration lifecycle is internally coherent. Unspecified values are execution inputs, not contradictory source requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test intent is identifiable. Platform field definitions, values and recovery must be supplied before execution but do not permanently block library review.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with the manual boundary and adds precise controller/device safety scope.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its valuable dependency and recovery controls but rejects PARTIAL based only on agent-collected read-only evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Restores MANUAL ONLY, bounds all/random and requires field-to-device correlation for this chipset domain.

review_improvement: Turns an unbounded chipset-page mutation into a named field/controller/device plan while preserving the original firmware lifecycle.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware navigation, chipset-field interpretation and visual acceptance are the core test operations and remain human. Automated inventories can detect collateral effects but cannot complete or replace those operations, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat a firmware change, reboot or default load after controller/device/boot anomalies; preserve first-failure evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
